blocks.text: WASHINGTON–LeBron James brushed off US President Donald Trump’s criticism of his behavior during the national anthem, calling it a “slow news day” after the Philadelphia 76ers rallied to beat the Cleveland Cavaliers 114-106 in the NBA on Thursday. “It must be a slow news day at the office,” James said after the game. “Slow news day at the office.” Trump lashed out at James earlier Thursday over what he called disrespectful behavior during the playing of the national anthem before the 76ers’ season opener against the New York Knicks on Tuesday.
